about: Every Amazon listing considered for the catalog, with what a plain listing-page check (scripts/verify-asins.mjs, no affiliate parameters) showed on the date given. "wired" ASINs are in VERIFIED_ASINS in lib/commerce/products/core.ts. Re-run the script weekly; restore parked entries when they read ok. Ratings and review counts are shown here for the maintainer only; the site never shows Amazon prices or ratings.
